import pytest

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def p(status="captured"):
    return Payment("pay_1","inv_1",Decimal("100.00"),status=status,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# full refund
x=p(); assert refund(x,Decimal("100.00"),T0) is x; assert x.status=="refunded" and x.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")
# multiple partials
x=p(); refund(x,Decimal("40.00"),T0); refund(x,Decimal("60.00"),T0); assert x.status=="refunded"
# over refund
x=p(); refund(x,Decimal("60.00"),T0)
try: refund(x,Decimal("50.00"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
# non-captured
for s in ("authorized","voided"):
    try: refund(p(s),Decimal("1.00"),T0); assert False
    except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="invalid_state"
# non-positive
for a in (Decimal("0"),Decimal("-1")):
    try: refund(p(),a,T0); assert False
    except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="non_positive_amount"
# naive datetime
try: refund(p(),Decimal("1.00"),datetime(2026,1,1)); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="naive_datetime"
print("all edge cases pass")
EOF"}
